### Do You Have Unmovable Faith?
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-apr-28-2010-11629524.html
Passage: Daniel 3:17-18
Points:
- Believers risk developing a soft and sentimental faith when they do not prepare for trials.
- God builds enduring faith through obedient perseverance during present difficulties.
- Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego modeled unshakable faith when threatened with death in the furnace.
- Their devotion to God was resolute regardless of whether He chose to rescue them.
- Christians are called to develop steadfast faith now so they can stand strong in future testing.
